finding: The preflight inventories all symlinks below /usr/include while prohibiting every resolution outside the three roots. Installed Python, OCaml, MPI and Clang include-directory symlinks resolve outside those roots, so literal admission fails before compilation even when those trees are unconsumed.
required_correction: Use a non-following inventory that records external directory links as excluded unconsumed entries and rejects any actual dependency that resolves through or into them; alternatively bind expanded roots. No consumed prerequisite may be silently excluded.
confirmed_coherent_scope: The object-only -c/-save-temps=obj strategy is a substantive simplification and installed GCC9 supports its output naming.
The retained completion status, immediate stop, separate cleanup budget, manager-side SIGKILL fallback and recursive hybrid-cgroup reconciliation address prior lifecycle findings.
All source, review, history and tool hashes match.
